title: TriAttention: Efficient Long Reasoning via Trigonometric KV Compression
summary: TriAttention is an open-source framework that optimizes KV cache compression by modeling pre-RoPE attention scores through trigonometric representations. It significantly reduces memory overhead for long-context reasoning models, enabling high-performance local deployment on consumer hardware.
research_notes: Developed by researchers from MIT and NVIDIA; achieves over 10x KV memory reduction with zero accuracy loss on benchmarks like AIME25.

evolution.summary: After its April 2026 release, the project was ported to llama.cpp (triattention-ggml) and integrated into SGLang. It currently supports AMD/ROCm and NVIDIA Blackwell architectures, often serving as a standard component for local reasoning model stacks alongside quantization tools.
